annotationNotes: Seven physical zones carry all eight printed source numbers. Hallway 1 and corridor 5 remain a single connected zone; the fixture adds no wall between them.
Native wall-face corners and existing fixed-service outlines are retained. Door/window openings are logically closed for room envelopes; that closure is not an assertion that a wall exists there.

Room 6 uses a corridor-side doorway closure to retain the two stepped reveal corners. This includes the entry threshold and is not the room-area polygon: the source explicitly excludes space under doorways from areas.
Room 8 free-floor contour excludes the visibly outlined service/riser box. The full interior envelope and fixed volume are retained separately.
No global centimetre scale, fitted coordinates, unknown opening heights, door swing envelopes, radiator dimensions, or construction guarantees are introduced.
Room 3 has two observed windows, widths 1089 and 576. The 576 opening is not classified as a balcony door.

Room 2 window and balcony spans share an exact bounded crossing of native operation 573/subpath 0/segment 0 with the declared top edge. Printed widths 563 and 926 are independently checked; the crossing is not an extracted vertex.
The source address/title block is deliberately not transcribed.
